proof_summary: Take the prime \(p=16843\): a modular harmonic-sum computation shows \(H_{p-1}=p^3R\) with \(p\nmid\operatorname{den}(R)\). Pairing each nonmultiple \(x\) of \(p\) below \(p^2\) with \(p^2-x\), and separating the multiples of \(p\), gives \(H_{p^2-2}-1=p^2Y\) with \(p\nmid\operatorname{den}(Y)\), so the composite \(p^2\) divides the reduced numerator-minus-denominator.
